name: Taifoon — batch judge scores for the coordination layer (TypeSafe/Jev)

nodes.name: Grade a batch
nodes.notes: in: — → out: — · start a batch (pass { subjects, jobId, threshold } or run the demo set)

nodes.name: Build the batch
nodes.notes: in: — → out: hire.json · one canonical HIRE per subject (a delivered handshake, or a job on chain); no state is built here

nodes.name: Judge · prepare
nodes.notes: in: hire.json → out: facts.json · POST /v1/judge/compose (prepare) per subject: the facts decide first; the pack is built from DELIVERY + FACTS; else the exact text Jev reads + prepare_digest

nodes.name: Hard fail?
nodes.notes: in: facts.json → out: facts.json · branch: a hard fail is final (Jev is not asked) and goes straight to the batch

nodes.name: Jev · TypeSafe (our credential)
nodes.notes: in: facts.json → out: answers.json · TypeSafe ask on the prepared text (jevStateOf): every RUBRIC_ASKED answer with its whole distribution

nodes.name: Judge · answers
nodes.notes: in: answers.json → out: verdict.json · POST /v1/judge/compose (answers): recompose under THRESHOLDS_v1, record decision.v2 and the answers (jev.answer.v1), anchor both

nodes.name: Grade + aggregate
nodes.notes: in: facts.json | verdict.json → out: — · the batch outcome from the recorded verdicts (Conformant / NonConformant / NoGrade counts, fail fraction vs threshold) — a batch record, not a canonical entity

nodes.name: Record the batch to the coordination layer
nodes.notes: in: — → out: — · POST /v1/judge/batch (relayer key): the batch record, keyed batch:<jobId>
